evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: Teachers who have not achieved tenure status shall be observed periodically at least four (4) times during the school year

evaluation_ratings_005.evidence: Provision shall be made for an over-all assessment by the evaluator which clearly indicates a satisfactory or unsatisfactory rating.

evaluation_student_growth_006.evidence: The evaluation shall be based on the observations of the teacher’s performance and other reasonable criteria established by local boards of education
